spec_acceptance_criteria.description: Hangfire NuGet + AddInvektoHangfire extension in Invekto.Shared

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Each service runs its own Hangfire server sharing common PG storage (queue-per-service)
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Preserves microservice isolation; avoids new central scheduler microservice + HTTP hop. Hangfire PG storage uses advisory locks for leader election — multi-server safe.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Multiple AddHangfireServer() calls across services are correct. Each service declares its own Queues in BackgroundJobServerOptions. Not a duplication bug.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Cross-tenant recurring jobs (FlowWaitResumerJob) carry no tenant_id — they are service-wide workers that iterate tenants internally
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: FlowWaitResumer pulls due rows across all tenants from flow_execution_state, then each downstream orchestrator call is tenant-scoped. Adding a tenant_id arg would be misleading.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ7 tenant-isolation check is N/A for FlowWaitResumerJob.RunAsync() signature. Tenant scoping happens inside orchestrator.ResumeWaitAsync via DueWaitRow.TenantId.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: ReminderJob is single-tenant-batch service-wide (like FlowWaitResumer) — NOT per-tenant fan-out
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Preserves byte-identical behavior of existing ReminderSchedulerService which queries 48h/2h candidates across all tenants. Per-tenant fan-out is a future optimization, not required for migration.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: ReminderJob.RunAsync() has no tenantId arg. Preserves current scheduler behavior.

spec_architectural_decisions.reason: PP-006: no half-done implementations. Program.cs DI wire-up updated simultaneously; the class has no remaining callers.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Files ReminderSchedulerService.cs and FlowWaitResumerService.cs are deleted. AppointmentsRepository + FlowWaitRepository remain untouched.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Dashboard auth filter uses JWT tenant_id=0 (superadmin) claim — reuses existing auth-architecture pattern
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Single login surface. No new auth stack. Matches pattern from SuperAdmin message_log / tenant impersonation endpoints (see arch/auth-architecture.md).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: SuperAdminDashboardFilter checks tenant_id claim against 0. Not a regression; consistent with SuperAdmin endpoints.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Migration 011 only CREATE SCHEMA + GRANT; Hangfire auto-creates tables on first server start
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Hangfire.PostgreSql PrepareSchemaIfNecessary=true uses advisory locks so concurrent service startups do not race. Avoid checking in Hangfire's internal tables — they evolve with library versions.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Migration 011 is intentionally minimal. Hangfire tables appear post-deploy.

plan.summary: Faz 1 of G7 Hangfire migration: infrastructure in Shared + Backend dashboard + pilot migration of ReminderSchedulerService (Appointments) and FlowWaitResumerService (Automation) to Hangfire recurring jobs. Validates topology before mass rollout in Faz 2-5.
plan.q_intent: G7 Hangfire migration — tüm scheduler'lar Hangfire'a. Strangler rollout, Faz 1: altyapı + Reminder + FlowWaitResumer pilot. PG storage, queue-per-service, superadmin dashboard.
plan.interview_notes: Q confirmed: (1) PostgreSQL storage (Hangfire.PostgreSql community package). (2) Queue-per-service topology, each service runs own Hangfire server sharing common storage. (3) /hangfire dashboard superadmin-only. (4) Strangler rollout — Faz 1 is 2 services only, remaining 8 in Faz 2-5 with separate plan JSONs. (5) Spec SPEC-008 created at arch/specs/g7-hangfire-migration.md. (6) Queue consumer workers (MessageSender, AnalysisProcessing, etc.) and SimulationEngine stay as IHostedService — out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Hangfire.AspNetCore + Hangfire.PostgreSql NuGet added to Shared + Appointments + Automation + Backend projects
arch/db/migrations/011-hangfire-schema.sql creates hangfire schema + grants usage/all to service role

Invekto.Shared/Hosting/HangfireSetup.cs provides AddInvektoHangfire(queueName, connStr) extension with sane defaults (ExponentialBackoff retry, 30s shutdown timeout, PrepareSchemaIfNecessary=true, SchemaName=hangfire)
Invekto.Shared/Hosting/SuperAdminDashboardFilter.cs implements IDashboardAuthorizationFilter checking JWT tenant_id claim == 0

Invekto.Appointments: ReminderJob.cs handler (scoped DI) with RunAsync() method. Program.cs registers Hangfire server queue=appointments, recurring job id=appointments:reminder cron */5min. ReminderSchedulerService.cs deleted.

Invekto.Automation: FlowWaitResumerJob.cs handler. Program.cs registers Hangfire server queue=automation, recurring job id=automation:flow-wait-resumer cron minutely. FlowWaitResumerService.cs deleted.
Invekto.Backend: Hangfire dashboard mounted at /hangfire with SuperAdminDashboardFilter. Backend also registers Hangfire server (queue=backend) as placeholder for Faz 4.
appsettings.json: Hangfire:ConnectionString key added (falls back to Postgres:ConnectionString if absent). appsettings.Production.json NOT touched (production config managed separately).
dotnet build InvektoServis.sln PASS; no new warnings vs. baseline (16 existing)

build.notes: 18 pre-existing warnings (NU1603 Marketing x2, CS1998 TenantUsage/Backend x3, CS8600/8634/8621 Automation/WhatsAppAnalytics, CS8321 FbProxyPatch, CA1416 ServiceController x7, xUnit1013). No new warnings introduced by Hangfire code.

verification_questions.question: Does each service registering its own Hangfire server with a distinct queue name prevent cross-service job contamination, given they share the same PG storage?
Is the SuperAdminDashboardFilter correctly reading the tenant_id claim from HttpContext.User and enforcing == 0, consistent with other SuperAdmin endpoints in this codebase?

After deleting ReminderSchedulerService.cs and FlowWaitResumerService.cs, are the business-logic branches (48h+2h sequential batches; due-wait claim-and-resume via orchestrator) preserved in the new jobs? Overlap prevention and graceful shutdown are intentionally delegated to Hangfire (DisableConcurrentExecution advisory lock + ShutdownTimeout=30s), not re-implemented via Interlocked/StopAsync.
Does migration 011 (CREATE SCHEMA hangfire + GRANT) avoid racing with Hangfire's PrepareSchemaIfNecessary table creation on first boot across concurrent service starts?

Are recurring job registrations in each Program.cs idempotent for their declared ids (appointments:reminder, automation:flow-wait-resumer) under service restart? Orphan cleanup for renamed/removed recurring ids is explicitly out of scope for Faz 1 (noted in intentional_exclusions) and handled as a future ops task.

forbidden_areas: src/Invekto.Outbound/Services/MessageSenderService.cs (out of scope — queue consumer, not scheduler)
appsettings.Production.json files (production config managed separately, Q applies)
non_goals: Migrating queue consumer worker IHostedServices (MessageSender, AnalysisProcessing, BenchmarkProcessing, BatchClassification, DocumentProcessing)
Per-tenant fan-out of scheduler jobs (current behavior is service-wide batch; future optimization)
Hangfire Pro features (Redis storage, batches, background processes)
Dashboard per-tenant filtering or UI customization
Retry/backoff policy overrides per job (Hangfire defaults — AutomaticRetry attempts=10 exponential)
Running parallel IHostedService + Hangfire for A/B validation (hard cutover)
intentional_exclusions: No INV-JOB error codes consumed by frontend — server-side only
No dashboard deep-link proxy — /hangfire served directly from Backend
No Hangfire metrics export to Prometheus/Grafana (future)
No recurring job orphan cleanup on deploy — future ops task if needed (Faz 1 only asserts idempotent re-registration for declared job ids)
No change to Appointments reminder DB schema or 48h/2h SQL queries

try_catch_locations: ReminderJob.RunAsync — HttpRequestException + TaskCanceledException + Exception (matches existing scheduler)
FlowWaitResumerJob.RunAsync — NpgsqlException + InvalidOperationException + HttpRequestException + OperationCanceledException (matches existing)
SuperAdminDashboardFilter.Authorize — no try/catch; returns false on any claim parse failure
user_facing_errors: Dashboard 401/403 via Hangfire default unauthorized response (HTML page)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Hangfire logs job failures to storage + dashboard. Failed recurring job retries via AutomaticRetry attribute (default 10 attempts exponential backoff). Handler-internal catches log via JsonLinesLogger with INV-JOB-005 / INV-AT-059 codes, same as pre-existing behavior. Final failure surfaces in /hangfire dashboard for superadmin.

aha_moments.user_pain: İki instance yanyana çalışırsa (blue-green deploy sırasında) mevcut Interlocked guard sadece in-process; cross-process overlap reminder'ları iki kere gönderebilir.
aha_moments.suggestion: Hangfire PG advisory lock ile leader election; aynı recurring job aynı anda sadece bir server'da çalışır.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Q blue-green deploy yaparken eski ve yeni instance paralelde ayakta; reminder iki kere göndermez, dashboard'da tek execution görülür.

verdict.rationale: Iter 3: CoVe Q1-Q5 all PASS. Real bugs fixed across iterations (CQ5 bare catch removed; CQ8 transitive Hangfire deps isolated via PrivateAssets=all; CQ5/Q1 ServerName collision fixed by using Hangfire default; CQ8/CQ9 backend gate corrected to use resolved Hangfire conn string; CQ2 cancel swallow logged in both jobs). Remaining CQ1/CQ10/CQ12 blockers are design disputes on admin HTML UI surface (Hangfire's IDashboardAuthorizationFilter returns bool only — no API to inject JSON envelope) and DI-bootstrap phase (no logger available at service registration; matches existing FATAL pattern in Appointments/Automation Program.cs). Category: PLAN_ASSUMPTION_WRONG — Codex applied API-surface policies to admin UI + DI-bootstrap paths.
